SideSpeed 0.5.4 fixes updating on Fire TV and makes Check for updates offer the update right away.

## Fixes
- **Updates work on Fire TV and Android 9.** On Android 9 boxes, including Fire TV, Update now stopped with "Could not read the downloaded APK." SideSpeed now reads the APK's signing key correctly there. It still refuses any APK it can't verify.
- **About → Check for updates offers the update.** When a newer version is out, a prompt opens with **Update now** selected. **Later** or Back closes it; the update notice on the Apps screen stays.

**Updating:** on Fire TV with SideSpeed 0.5.2 or 0.5.3, update once with Downloader (code **3503400**) or `sidespeed.app/tv`, because those versions can't install updates on Android 9. Elsewhere, press **Update now** on the update notice, or **About → Check for updates**. From 0.4.0 or earlier, update once with Downloader.

Updating stops the helper, as before. On Google TV, open SideSpeed to start it again; on Fire TV, the Companion starts it.

The Companion apps have no changes in this release.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.5.4.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.4.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.4-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.4-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.4-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
